DuoAero 1.3.7 is a development preview based on the original 6.103.5 Android runtime. It is not the completed app.

The 29 existing symbolic formula-block exercises now have a word practice and a named quantity placed in the mathematical formula before the symbolic exercise. For example, the ideal-gas exercise places the temperature block directly after p = ρRₐ. The 1.3.7 candidate also targets missed quick taps, restores the original chest reward presentation and fixes a profile drawable crash that could prevent access to update settings. The path has one chest at the end of each of seven topics. Old exact lesson identities are retained for progress validation.

An Android emulator with S24 Ultra proportions, dark mode and increased font size selected and graded 12 representative word, named-formula and symbolic exercises, including a fraction and an exponent. A separate diagnostic completed the first Atmosphere lesson with a formula hint, end-of-lesson retry, Claim XP, saved progress and next-lesson selection after restart; earlier nodes were seeded. A diagnostic chest granted 25 gems and the balance survived restart. A synthetic-profile diagnostic reached the original update settings. These do not prove physical-phone behavior, a real Google account or Drive sync, or installation through the updater.

The preview contains more distinct transparent Snoopy and Peanuts artwork, including selected original character rigs. Static pose and character mapping is partial; many scenes still use generic artwork. Some character sequences mainly move a single drawing rather than fully animating the character; animation smoothness and coverage have not been established across the app. Not every calculation has a reviewed formula hint, not all equations and explanations have been audited, and the full course has not been traversed. The course currently covers the first midterm only.

The release is intended for development channel A. Channel B remains empty; installing or updating from the app was not verified.
